text:
OpsBot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: routing anomalies and repeated fallback loops for /v1/generate (INC-3013579). Elevated 5xx from eu-west1 -> rapid failover to us-east1, then back. Automatic mitigation attempted but observed oscillation.

Aisha: I’m on pager. grabbing logs + routing traces now.

Jun: I can see the loop in the routing service traces — requests from eu-west1 hit variant 'v-small-quant' (unexpected), then fail capacity checks and bounce to us-east1 which is saturated, then origin re-routes back. Pattern started ~03:06 UTC.

Sam: any recent config changes? we pushed the schema translation migration yesterday night (tools/schema-translator v2.0).

Jun: yes that translation is my suspicious. It rewrites legacy field `prefer_model_variant` -> `route_policy.prefer_variant=true` when present. For a small set of customers the old field was used as a hint and defaulted to false in the runtime, but the translator sets it to true by default. That forces traffic to the smaller variant even when it can't handle load.

Lina (CS): We already got a support ticket from BrightFile complaining about incorrect model behavior and big latencies starting ~03:10. They said responses are short and fallbacked to the low-capacity variant.

Marcus (SRE): Paging graph: cpu on us-east1 routing-proxies at 98%, error budget breached on the route group.

Aisha: Can we stop the translator and roll back to previous version? quick mitigation idea: revert translator mapping for `prefer_model_variant` to leave unset, and temporarily pin customers to `route_policy.allow_fallback=false`.

Sam: Rolling translator back to v1.9 now. Doing a deploy rollback of tools/schema-translator -> 1.9 (will post status).

OpsBot: Deploy started by Sam.

Jun: While the rollback is in flight — we should set a temporary routing override to disable cross-region fallback for affected route group `/v1/generate` so we don't oscillate. I’ll push a strict route policy: `route_overrides['/v1/generate'] = { allow_cross_region_fallback: false }` for the prod cluster.

Sam: I can apply the override, pushing now (dry-run -> apply).

Sam: Applied override. Confirming proxies accepted the new policy.

Jun: Nice, I'm already seeing fewer cross-region handoffs in traces. Error rate in eu-west1 is still high but no more bouncing.

Lina (CS): Noted. I'll tell BrightFile we have a mitigation and are working on a rollback/patch. They asked for ETA on full resolution.

Marcus (SRE): Rolling capacity bump in eu-west1 compute pool as a short-term relief — adding 4 nodes.

OpsBot: incident-bot created INC-3013579 and attached runbook "routing-fallback-loop". Assigned to: Jun, Aisha, Marcus.

Aisha: Quick repro snippet from traces:
```
# simplified trace
client -> proxy(eu-west1) -> router -> runtime(v-small-quant) [OOM/queue] -> fallback to us-east1 -> latency spike -> router re-routes back to eu-west1
```

Jun: Root cause summary so far: schema translator v2.0 changed semantics of deprecated field `prefer_model_variant` by mapping it to a strong routing preference rather than a hint. Combined with model autoscaling thresholds and regional capacity patterns this caused traffic to be pinned to undersized variants and then oscillate when failover triggered.

Sam: Rollback to translator v1.9 complete. Confirming the mapping change is gone.

Jun: Ok I can see the translator no longer sets `route_policy.prefer_variant`. Now runtime sees legacy field absent and takes default safe behavior (no forced variant).

Marcus (SRE): eu-west1 node addition finishing, proxies falling back to 70% CPU. Error rate trending downward.

OpsBot: Pager update: error rate down 82% vs peak. No further oscillation observed in the last 3 minutes.

Lina (CS): BrightFile updated: they see latency improving, but want a postmortem.

Aisha: Handoff: I need to step off in 15. Jun taking on-call for mitigation follow-up and RCA writeup. Marcus will monitor infra scaling and follow up on capacity decisions.

Jun: I’ll take it. Plan: write incident timeline, collect translator config diff, add extra unit/integration tests in schema-translator for legacy-field semantics, and schedule a canary with stricter monitoring before redeploy.

Sam: Action items I’m taking: add a feature-flag gating mapped semantics so translator never flips hint->forced without explicit opt-in. Also add a deploy-time safety check to refuse mappings that change default boolean semantics for deprecated fields.

Marcus (SRE): I’ll queue a capacity runbook entry: add emergency scaling policy for region proxies to avoid single-region saturation when fallback starts.

Aisha: Thanks team. Leaving notes in the incident thread and attaching logs to INC-3013579.

OpsBot: Incident status -> mitigated. Next steps: RCA doc (Jun), patch PR for schema-translator (Sam), capacity runbook update (Marcus), CS customer follow-up (Lina). Paging cleared.

Jun: Will produce RCA and link it here within 24h.

Lina (CS): I’ll prepare a customer-facing summary for affected tenants and coordinate support responses.

Sam: Postmortem checklist: include the translator change, diff for mapping, tests added, rollout plan for redeploy with canary, and expected timeline.

Marcus (SRE): Leaving monitoring alerts tightened on route oscillation metrics and adding an automated circuit-breaker to stop aggressive fallbacks if cross-region handoff > 3 in 5m.

Aisha: handing off. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

Jun: acknowledged, taking over.

incident-bot: Incident INC-3013579 changed status -> RESOLVED (mitigated) at 03:30 UTC. Postmortem scheduled.
